description: Use when the traveler wants a hotel or a place to stay for known dates, tonight included: in a city or neighbourhood, near a landmark, venue or airport (near Heathrow, near the convention center), or a hotel by name. Returns hotels cheapest first with star class, guest rating, per-night and whole-stay price, what is nearby, hotel_ids and a search_key for track_hotel and hotel_price_calendar, and a search_url. Its filters are the site's own. Not for flexible months (add_hotel_bucket_list).

adults.description: Adults. A hotel room prices up to 6 guests in all; vacation rentals up to 16.

amenities.description: Hotels: free parking, pool, gym, spa, free breakfast, beach access, pet-friendly, child-friendly, free wi-fi, air conditioning, all-inclusive, wheelchair accessible, ev charger, bar, restaurant, room service. Vacation rentals: kitchen, hot tub, fireplace, patio, grill, crib, beach access, pet-friendly, gym, air conditioning.

brand.description: Only stays of this brand or chain, matched in the hotel's name. Put the city in location, the brand here.

currency.description: The traveler's currency, when they name one or their words show where they live (euros in Spain, or writing in French from Lyon). Empty: US dollars or their SlickTrip currency. Amounts you send stay US dollars.

location.description: A city, neighbourhood, landmark, airport or venue, or a hotel name.

max_price_per_night.description: Highest price per night to show, USD.

min_bedrooms.description: Vacation rentals with at least this many bedrooms ("a 5-bedroom house": 5). Searches vacation rentals; each home says its bedrooms, bathrooms and how many it sleeps.

min_guest_rating.description: Lowest guest rating out of 5; 3.5, 4 or 4.5 work best. A rating out of 10 (8 and up) is read as half.

min_price_per_night.description: Lowest price per night to show, USD.

property_kinds.description: Hotels: resort, boutique hotel, hostel, inn, motel, spa hotel, bed and breakfast, apartment hotel, beach hotel, ryokan. Vacation rentals: apartment, house, villa, cabin, cottage, chalet, bungalow, houseboat.

sort.description: Cheapest first, or best rated first.

user_request.description: Optional, and it works in the traveler's favor. Quote the traveler's latest message about this trip exactly as they wrote it (their wording, language and spelling), not a summary: when a search fails or comes back empty, SlickTrip compares their words with the arguments sent and returns a corrected search, so you can fix it without asking again (it has caught Cancun sent as MEX, and travelers dropped from the party). If the message only answers a question ("yes, the 20th"), quote the one that asked for the trip. Send the same quote on every call for this request. Leave out anything not about the trip, and never names, contact details, or payment or ID information. The words also help SlickTrip improve its search.
examples: necesito llevar a mi mamá de Calgary a Kolkata a fines de octubre, no puede hacer escala en Estados Unidos

name: search_hotels

code.description: On an error: a machine-readable kind, e.g. unknown_place

filters.description: Applied filters: property_type, min_stars, free_cancellation, min_bedrooms, advanced, sort

highlights.description: The spread over every priced stay: cheapest, best_rated, cheapest_4_star_plus, most_reviewed; each with hotel_id, name, per_night_usd, total_usd, stars, guest_rating, reviews

hotels.description: Items: hotel_id, name, image, type, stars, guest_rating, reviews, per_night_usd, total_usd, amenities, description, hotel_url; vacation rentals add sleeps, bedrooms, bathrooms

message.description: Error or sign-in message from the server wrapper

note.description: Prices are whole-stay; how to track

places_assumed.description: Place names this call resolved on its own, e.g. 'Portland = Portland, OR (PDX)'; tell the traveler

search.description: location, check_in, check_out, adults, children_ages, nights, search_key

searched_as.description: What the search assumed: guests, hotels or vacation rentals

suggestions.description: On unknown_place: places to offer the traveler, each with code, name, kind (airport, all airports in the city, nearby airport), city, country

total_found.description: Total hotels found before max_results cut
